title: The hip thrust: is it the BEST glute exercise? 🍑
caption:
Hip thrusts light up the glutes more than squats in muscle activity tests, but a 2023 study found both built about the same glute size. Squats or hip thrusts? 👇

Exercise Series, Part 6
first_comment: Team squat or team hip thrust? 🍑
sources: Contreras B et al. A comparison of gluteus maximus, biceps femoris, and vastus lateralis electromyographic activity in the back squat and barbell hip thrust exercises. J Appl Biomech 2015;31:452-458
Plotkin DL et al. Hip thrust and back squat training elicit similar gluteus muscle hypertrophy and transfer similarly to the deadlift. Front Physiol 2023;14:1279170
